parameters.name: PageIndex
parameters.description: The page number for a paged query. The value must be greater than or equal to 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 500.

parameters.name: SortBy
parameters.description:
The field used for sorting. By default, results are sorted by purchase time. Valid values:

- CreateTime: purchase time.
- ExpireTime: expiration time.

parameters.name: SortOrder
parameters.description:
The sort order. Default value: desc. Valid values:

- asc: ascending order.
- desc: descending order.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the build task. Valid values:

- int: initialization
- pending: preparing
- building: building
- succeed: build succeeded
- failed: build failed
- canceled: canceled
